11 / Behind the salon doors

About the Ada site

Programming history, curiosity and humour at the same table. This is the story of a website that even sent Ada Lovelace to the beach with a laptop.

Made with ideas, code and a little strong tea.

Lecturer · IT specialist · educator

Miroslav Reiter is a lecturer and founder of IT Academy and the VITA learning platform. His work focuses on practical education in IT, marketing and management.

02 / From brief to salon

How this website was made

The site grows through collaboration between Miroslav Reiter and the AI tools ChatGPT and Codex. Miroslav sets the purpose, content and direction; AI assists with design, writing, translation, programming and checks.

  1. 01

    An idea with a spark

    Introduce Ada Lovelace clearly and with humour. Her historical biography gained some unusual company: imaginary startups, a modern CV and tea-powered programming.

  2. 02

    Content you can try

    The portfolio grew to include a quiz, time machine, punched cards, advice, newspaper and gallery. Visitors can explore, click and learn at their own pace.

  3. 03

    Five languages, one salon

    Slovak is the default language. The entire site is also available in Czech, English, German and Spanish, with light, dark and system appearance modes and reading preferences.

  4. 04

    Test, refine, save

    We check updates on desktop and mobile, including links and controls. Finished versions are published through Sites, with source files backed up on GitHub.

Under the bonnet

The pages use HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Python generates the language editions from shared templates. You can explore the code and supporting files in the repository.

03 / Editorial principles

Facts have sources. Humour has a home.

01

Historical facts

Information about Ada is grounded in the cited sources. Links to historical documents, museums and books are collected in a dedicated source library.

02

Clearly labelled fiction

TeaScript, Steam Cloud, the modern CV and salon jokes are creative fiction. They are not Ada's real inventions, quotations or work experience.

03

Portraits and AI imagination

Historical portraits include their provenance. Modern beach scenes are AI-generated images labelled as fiction. They are not historical photographs.

Open historical sources and books ↗

Comfortable without a magnifying glass

We consider readability, contrast, mobile layouts and keyboard use as we make changes. The site is tested and improved over time; this is not a claim of full WCAG certification.

Ada was ahead of her time. We are trying to keep this website up to speed with your phone.
